kind: bounded mathematical mechanism analysis, not an experiment or a frozen launch protocol
uses: existing R82-R86 source/objective/protocol evidence only; no new image, feature, prediction, optimizer or VAL access

representer_observation.meaning: R84 independent normals remove the NCM mean-normal constraint, but the learned residual remains in the support-feature span. More free classifier parameters do not by themselves add independent evidence for rare classes.
representer_observation.R85_extension: With fixed class-graph quadratic penalty, left multiplication mixes class coefficient rows; feature-direction span is still the span of the same S features.
representer_observation.R86_extension: Patch changes the support/query feature kernel, while duplicated CLS retains the original dot-product kernel. Both per-arm prototype normalization and fitted residuals change; the observed contrast does not isolate a single causal explanation.
not_implied: No proof that residuals cannot correct any Q error
No proof that all fixed representations are insufficient
No proof of unique overfitting cause
No authorization to change anchor or search feature modules

three_distinct_questions.question: Does utility transfer?
three_distinct_questions.evidence: R82/R83 yes in rank, but no stable recognition gain; scalar proxy transfer is not sufficient recognition feedback.

three_distinct_questions.question: Can fixed-feature supervised boundaries correct mistakes?
three_distinct_questions.evidence: R84 partially yes; tiny targets mostly unchanged. Does not identify a universal representation bottleneck.

three_distinct_questions.question: Does added fixed image information help?
three_distinct_questions.evidence: R86 globally and in final stage yes conditional on this fixed protocol, but early losses/tiny gate failure remain. Does not license choosing later stages.

candidate_for_scrutiny_not_approved_laun.hypothesis: A pooled within-class residual covariance estimated from sufficiently supported arrived S classes contains transferable nuisance geometry for rare-class decisions, beyond S class means or a fixed label graph.
candidate_for_scrutiny_not_approved_laun.distinct_basis: R84 unit isotropic residual anchoring and R85 class-graph sharing do not explicitly estimate shared within-class feature noise. Long-tail class sample counts make independent per-rare-class covariance unreliable. This is a known statistical hypothesis, not new RL or new independent observations.
candidate_for_scrutiny_not_approved_laun.currently_missing_evidence: No measured cross-class covariance-transfer advantage has been established. Anisotropy alone is not a justification: it can be class-specific, estimation noise, or in discriminative directions.
candidate_for_scrutiny_not_approved_laun.mathematical_conditional: Under shared-covariance Gaussian class conditionals, equal-prior discriminant normals are Sigma^{-1}*mu_c with class-specific quadratic offsets. This conditional model is not established for these unit embeddings.
candidate_for_scrutiny_not_approved_laun.prospective_first_test: S-only component-held-out residual covariance predictive likelihood, all six stages and both original folds; compare one analytic shrinkage estimator against spherical covariance and a prespecified same-spectrum orientation control. No Q labels/predictions, no classifier reward/selector search. Must freeze exact eligible-class/component rules, likelihood denominators, estimator, controls, cost and stop gates before any new fit/CPU experiment.
candidate_for_scrutiny_not_approved_laun.reject_if: Cross-class/component predictive transfer does not beat both controls consistently; covariance anisotropy or improved S fit alone is insufficient. Do not respond with shrinkage/metric/strength sweeps.
candidate_for_scrutiny_not_approved_laun.later_action_only_if_supported: A separately frozen classification test with identical S/Q and matched controls would still be required; improved covariance likelihood alone cannot claim macro/tail or RL gain.
candidate_for_scrutiny_not_approved_laun.authorization_scope: No patch variant, fusion, temperature, lowLR, R65, R79 or D13 branch restored. Overall mainline analysis authorization remains active.

next_required_work: Evaluate whether the covariance-transfer first test has enough support components and whether prior recorded work already tested the same mechanism; then either freeze one bounded S-only protocol or explicitly reject this candidate. Do not return to idle repeated completion checks.
